goal: Avoid temporary HashSet allocation when scan planning only needs to know whether an expression contains any column reference.
scope: No semantic changes to predicate eligibility, point lookup, range lookup, or EXPLAIN output
implementation: Replace the temporary HashSet-based `expr_has_column_reference` path with direct recursive boolean traversal.
Short-circuit traversal once any supported expression node contains a column reference.
Keep the covered expression shapes aligned with `extract_columns_from_expr`.
